mapper.sql: FROM sys_organization_user ou INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ou.user_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = ou.user_id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ou.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND ou.enable = 1 AND rp.permission_id = 'TASK:EXECUTE' AND (r.internal = 1 OR r.organization_id = #{organizationId})
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.name, t.source, t.assignee_id, assignee.name AS assignee_name, t.customer_id, customer.name AS customer_name, t.description, t.deadline, t.status, t.report_content, t.ai_reply, t.started_at, t.completed_at, t.report_submitted_at, t.create_time, t.update_time, t.create_user, t.update_user FROM crm_task t LEFT JOIN sys_user assignee ON assignee.id = t.assignee_id LEFT JOIN customer ON customer.id = t.customer_id AND customer.organization_id = t.organization_id WHERE t.id = #{id} AND t.organization_id = #{organizationId}

SELECT DISTINCT u.id, u.name
ORDER BY u.name

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) FROM sys_organization_user ou INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ou.user_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = ou.user_id WHERE ou.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND ou.enable = 1 AND ur.role_id = 'sales_staff' AND u.id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_task (id, organization_id, name, source, business_key, assignee_id, customer_id, description, deadline, status, report_content, ai_reply, started_at, completed_at, report_submitted_at, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user) VALUES (#{task.id}, #{task.organizationId}, #{task.name}, #{task.source}, #{task.businessKey}, #{task.assigneeId}, #{task.customerId}, #{task.description}, #{task.deadline}, #{task.status}, #{task.reportContent}, #{task.aiReply}, #{task.startedAt}, #{task.completedAt}, #{task.reportSubmittedAt}, #{task.createTime}, #{task.updateTime}, #{task.createUser}, #{task.updateUser})
